title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Account Terms Schedule — Payment Terms, Interest and Minimum Payment Figures
content:
The figures below are the billing terms of each Ridgeline Pro Credit tier. The Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge and Pro Revolving Charge Plus let the business carry a balance from month to month by paying a minimum; every Ridgeline Commercial Account tier is pay-in-full, so each invoice must be paid in full by its due date.

## Terms and carried balances

| Tier | Payment terms (calendar days) | Balance may be carried | Statement due date (days after statement date) | Grace period (days after statement date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 25 | Yes | 25 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 25 | Yes | 25 | 25 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 30 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 45 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 60 | No | 0 | 0 |

Payment terms run from the invoice date on a commercial account and from the statement date on a revolving account. A statement due-date figure of 0 means the pay-in-full account's invoices carry their own due dates. The grace period is the number of days after the statement date by which paying the full statement balance avoids interest on a revolving account; it is 0 on a pay-in-full account.

## Interest

| Tier | Annual percentage rate (percent per year) | Days in the year for the daily rate | Minimum interest charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 27.49 | 365 | 2.00 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 25.49 | 365 | 2.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 0.00 | 365 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 0.00 | 365 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 0.00 | 365 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 0.00 | 365 | 0.00 |

The annual rate is turned into a daily periodic rate by dividing it by one hundred and then by the days-in-year figure. The minimum interest charge applies when computed interest is above zero but below it; a figure of 0.00 means there is none.

## Minimum payment

| Tier | Minimum payment percentage of the statement balance | Minimum payment floor (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 3.00 | 50.00 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 2.50 | 75.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 100.00 | 0.00 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 100.00 | 0.00 |

A percentage of 100.00 means the full statement balance is due. The floor is the lowest minimum payment on a revolving statement whose balance is at or above it; it is 0.00 on a pay-in-full account.

Hypothetical illustration: at 27.49 percent a year over 365 days, the daily periodic rate of a Pro Revolving Charge balance is 27.49 divided by one hundred, divided by 365, about 0.000753 per day.
